text.description_html:
Acorn IPFBP, Seville Iron Art Door Handle

Great for outside doors and gates, this hand forged pull features an elegant, curved grip with a diamond shaped top mount tip. The black iron finish has a lifetime no-rust warranty. Made by Acorn, the IPFBP surface mounded Seville pull measures 9-5/8 inches high. It has have a rustic feel from a time when a blacksmith would hand-forge hardware so that this hearty pulls exude an old world charm onto any door.

Iron Art is a unique line of products created by using the techniques of the traditional forge. Each piece is fabricated with a rare craftsmanship reminiscent of a time when expert artisans, hammer in hand, transformed pure iron into simple yet functional designs. The result is individual works of art made in an old world style. We are proud to offer these high quality pieces to complement your home.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Features of the Seville Forged Iron Door Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 9-5/8"
  • Width: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 2-1/2"

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application. This door pull is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
